name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 16V — WSON
description: Cluster of surface-mount 16V low-dropout (LDO) linear regulator power ICs using WSON footprint patterns.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a surface-mount 16V LDO linear regulator IC.
Verify PCB compatibility with the WSON-6-1EP 2x2mm 0.65mm pitch land pattern.
Choose between tier A KiCad symbol entries including TLV76701DRVx and TLV76750DRVx.
avoid_when: The PCB design requires through-hole or non-SMD components.
The required footprint is not WSON-6-1EP with 2x2mm package dimensions.
The circuit requires a voltage rating other than 16V or a non-LDO regulator topology.
